CustomField.description: PacPoint KN070519 - Created for HPEAP Transcript Request
CustomField.formula:
IF ( ( (SignatureFirstName__c <> FirstName__c ||
SignatureLastName__c <> LastName__c) &&
(SignatureFirstName__c <> "" ||
SignatureLastName__c <> "")
) ,True , False)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This flag is automatically checked if the First Name and Last name does not match the Signature. It is assumed that if they don't match then they are requests from third parties.
CustomField.label: Third Party Requests
